description:
"What if Detective Sherlock Holmes of the century was a woman ?!" How does a masterpiece change with just one change? Will love grow with Dr. John Watson? Do you struggle with behavioral constraints? Villain Moriarty?? .. ㅡ The author [Kim Dal](https://www.mangaupdates.com/authors.html?id=46171854797) returned to show all the crystallized imagination. 19C London, Baker Street, Lady Sherlock, she's just "Woman" but dressed in male attire, and just "Man" Dr. John Watson enjoys a quick mystery adventure!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/lady_sherlock), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/lady_sherl), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/63209616), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4419007040)
